sections.content: The MRI of both temporomandibular joints, performed on December 24, 2020 for limited jaw opening, shows severe arthritis in both joints. The left side has progressed compared with the prior MRI, while the right side is not significantly changed. Both discs are displaced toward the front and inside and do not return to their normal position when the mouth opens. Treatment decisions require evaluation by the treating dentist, oral and maxillofacial surgeon, or another qualified clinician.
